topic: The Attention Mechanism: How Transformers Read
target_audience: University students with basic programming/linear algebra knowledge

sections.title: The Intuition: Contextual Focus
lecture_lines: Traditional models process words in isolation.
Human language relies on context and focus.
"It" refers back to "animal" in this sentence.
animations: Display 5 text nodes for words in a sentence at center. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate highlighting one focused word in #FF00FF and dim others.
Draw a box around context window behind focused word in #00FFFF.
Show directional paths from focused word to context words in #FFFF00.
Transition: Fade out non-contextual words, leave focus word and lines.

sections.title: The Query, Key, and Value Metaphor
lecture_lines: Think of attention as a library search.
Query is what you are searching for.
Key is the tag; Value is the content.
animations: Display Query(Q), Key(K), and Value(V) boxes centered. Colors: Q=#FF5733, K=#33FF57, V=#3357FF.
Animate Query box sliding right toward set of Key boxes.
Flash matching Key and Value boxes simultaneously in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Visualizing the Calculation: Scaled Dot-Product
lecture_lines: We represent words as mathematical vectors.
Dot products measure the similarity between words.
Higher similarity means higher attention weight.
Attention is a weighted sum of values.
The formula scales values by dot products.
animations: Display vector representations of Q and K side-by-side. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate a projection line between Q and K in #FFFF00.
Animate dot-product numerical value label appearing above #00FF00.
Scale the result using sqrt(d_k) factor in #FF00FF.
Display resulting attention weight score highlighting clearly in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Softmax and Weight Normalization
lecture_lines: Softmax turns scores into a probability distribution.
This ensures all attention weights sum to one.
The model highlights the most relevant word.
animations: Display bar chart of initial attention scores. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate Softmax function transformation curving the tops. Color: #FFFF00.
Scale bars so total height sums to 1.0. Color: #00FF00.

sections.title: Synthesis: From One Word to Understanding
lecture_lines: Different heads track different linguistic features.
This creates a rich, multi-dimensional understanding.
animations: Display multiple Value vector streams coming together. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate streams merging into one resultant vector. Color: #FF00FF.
Zoom in on the final context-aware vector in #00FFFF.
